identityReview: Matched Falguni Nayar, Nykaa founder, through IIMA oral-history archive, official director biography, shareholder resolution and latest earnings release. Distinguished daughter Adwaita Nayar and son Anchit Nayar, who have separate business roles. IIMA explicitly gives 1963; no exact birthday or stale wealth estimate adopted.
lifeStatusEvidence: November 4, 2026 company quarterly release quotes Falguni Nayar as executive chairperson, founder and CEO discussing operating efficiency and growth. Current director page identifies executive chairperson, managing director and CEO.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read Nykaa director biography and company history, IIMA archive text, relevant November 2026 results passages, EY award announcement, PTI listing coverage, Nykaa Fashion history and appointment provisions plus January 2026 voting outcome. NSE listing page initially opened but follow-up redirected to inaccessible host; listing date corroborated using PTI body. Investor presentation PDF exceeded tool size limit; no unsupported 2015 product milestone adopted.
sourceReview.scope: Education, consulting and banking career, founding, fashion platform, listing, award chronology, reappointment and current activity.
corrections: IIMA archive gives BCom at Sydenham College and PGP 1983–1985. Official company biography calls the qualification a postgraduate diploma in management. Do not automatically relabel as an MBA or doctorate, or invent undergraduate graduation year.

IIMA confirms 1963 birth year and Kotak Mahindra entry in 1993, with nearly two decades in Mumbai, London and New York. Corporate biography says 18 years; no precise unverified leaving anniversary derived from rounded tenure.
Nykaa founding in 2012 is supported by company history and IIMA. Separate postal notice identifies first director and CEO from April 24, 2012; not all later combined titles are backdated to that day.

Nykaa Fashion official page confirms 2018 launch. Its historical Adwaita title and stale brand/customer counts are not assumed current as of 2026; company products and business-unit work are not attributed solely to Falguni.
PTI November 10, 2021 report describes FSN E-Commerce Ventures shares debuting on BSE and NSE. Listing date is distinct from IPO subscription, allocation, corporate valuation or personal cash income.

EY India release dated April 12, 2022 awards the overall EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2021. Distinct from Start-up category 2019. Representation at the upcoming world competition does not mean a global overall win.

November 2025 board approval was subject to shareholders. December 26 postal notice specifies February 12, 2026–February 11, 2031; January 29 outcome reports shareholders approved on January 28. Profile distinguishes vote, announcement and effective date, without claiming future years served.

November 4, 2026 quarterly release concerns Q2 FY2027, ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated GMV, operating revenue, EBITDA, pretax and after-tax profits are different measures; brief profile does not merge them or treat management expectations as results.

Official history and director pages contain older operational counts and outside-directorship wording. These are not repeated as newly verified current facts. No independent cosmetics efficacy, universal customer satisfaction or promotional ranking assertion.
sourceReview.limits: AI authored and reviewed, not human/native-language certified. Relevant filing passages read, not full financial audit or verification of product claims. Corporate forecasts are not independently validated.
